sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Memefusion is a Match 3 game where players swap adjacent tiles to create sets of three or more identical memes. The game features a variety of meme types, each with its unique effects and rewards. The game's grid size can be adjusted, allowing players to choose between a compact 4x4 grid and a larger 6x6 grid. The game also features a timer, adding an extra layer of challenge and pressure to the gameplay. As players progress through the levels, the game introduces new memes, level layouts, and obstacles, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.

One of the standout features of Memefusion is its meme-based scoring system. Players earn points for creating sets of memes, and the game features a variety of special power-ups and bonuses that can significantly boost the score. The game also features a daily rewards system, providing players with a sense of progression and accomplishment. Additionally, the game features a leaderboards system, allowing players to compete with friends and other players from around the world.

Overall, Memefusion's core gameplay mechanics are engaging, easy to learn, and challenging to master. The game's simplicity and accessibility make it an excellent choice for players of all skill levels, while its depth and complexity ensure that it remains engaging for experienced players.
